sites.functional_impact_measured: Anti-FLAG immunofluorescence for both total and surface expression confirmed cell-surface display of the FLAG-tagged receptor.
sites.rationale: ADRA1D is a class A GPCR with no native signal peptide; the topology landmarks place residues 1–98 extracellular and TM1 beginning at residue 99, giving 98 residues of clearance from the tag to the first TM helix. L9 directly reports surface-confirmed FLAG display on full-length ADRA1D in the PRESTO-TANGO system. No residue number is stated in the clip, but because the N-terminus is the only extracellular terminus of this receptor, the junction is unambiguously a prepend before Met-1. Python confirmed seq[0]='M', consistent with residue_after='M'. PRESTO-TANGO system: a cleavable signal sequence and FLAG epitope tag were added at the 5′-end of the full-length ADRA1D construct expressed in HEK293 cells; after signal cleavage the FLAG resides at the receptor N-terminus. No residue number is stated; ADRA1D has no native signal peptide and its N-terminus (residues 1–98) is the sole extracellular terminus, so the junction is topology-derived as a prepend (insert_after_residue=0).

sources.claim: In preliminary experiments, each TANGO-ized construct was transfected and then examined by anti-FLAG immunofluorescence for both total and surface expression ( Fig. 1b for examples).
To test this possibility, HEK293 cells were transiently transfected with N-terminal SNAP-epitope tagged α 1D -AR cDNA constructs (SNAP-α 1D ).

literature_notes: All nine ledger lines converge on the extracellular N-terminus of α1-adrenergic receptors. L1 and L8/L9 are direct evidence for ADRA1D itself; L3–L7 are indirect (α1A-AR ortholog) and corroborate the same N-terminal position. No ledger line reports any insertion in ECL1 (155–170), ECL2 (234–253), or ECL3 (371–383) of ADRA1D or its close orthologs, so no internal loop sites are proposed. The C-terminus (residues 405–572) is intracellular per the topology landmarks and is not a surface-tag candidate. L6 (FLAG+T4-lysozyme fusion at the N-terminus of α1A-AR for cryo-EM) was considered but not used as a primary ledger line because it is indirect (ortholog) and the same N-terminal position is already better supported by direct ADRA1D evidence (L1, L8/L9). L2 is the same construct and paper as L1 and adds no independent site. L3, L4, L5, and L7 are all indirect ortholog evidence for the same N-terminal prepend position already covered by L1 and L8/L9.
